turns.assistant_text:
Here are some recent programs that have been announced:

1. **Thí điểm chương trình giáo dục mầm non mới**: Starting from the first semester of the 2026-2027 school year, a new preschool education program will be piloted at 510 educational institutions across the country. [Read more](https://www.sggp.org.vn/thi-diem-chuong-trinh-giao-duc-mam-non-moi-phat-huy-tinh-chu-dong-linh-hoat-post864486.html).

2. **Chương trình mục tiêu quốc gia giai đoạn 2026-2030**: This program aims to build new rural areas, sustainably reduce poverty, and develop the socio-economic conditions of ethnic minorities and mountainous regions. [Read more](https://baosonla.vn/van-hoa-xa-hoi/dong-luc-moi-tu-chuong-trinh-muc-tieu-quoc-gia-giai-doan-2026-2030-R1BsocEDR.html).

3. **Chương trình “CEO Việt Nam kỷ nguyên mới”**: Launched by VCCI, this program aims to enhance management capacity, promote innovation, and integrate Vietnamese businesses into the global market for the period of 2026-2030. [Read more](https://nhandan.vn/vcci-khoi-dong-chuong-trinh-ceo-viet-nam-ky-nguyen-moi-giai-doan-2026-2030-post977788.html).

4. **Khởi động Chương trình "CEO Việt Nam Kỷ nguyên mới"**: On July 25, VCCI organized the launch of a program aimed at developing leadership in Vietnamese enterprises for the 2026-2030 period. [Read more](https://vietnam.vnanet.vn/vietnamese/tin-van/khoi-dong-chuong-trinh-quotceo-viet-nam-ky-nguyen-moiquot-giai-doan-2026-2030-458734.html).

5. **Thí điểm Chương trình Giáo dục mầm non mới tại Lâm Đồng**: From the 2026-2027 school year, Lâm Đồng province will pilot the new preschool education program at 15 representative institutions. [Read more](https://thuonghieucongluan.com.vn/lam-dong-thi-diem-chuong-trinh-giao-duc-mam-non-moi-tai-15-co-so-tu-nam-hoc-2026-2027-a328349.html).

Let me know if you need more information!
